.husky/pre-commit.local.IMPLICIT: a commit staging the vault data runs its checker and is refused on any fault it prints: data/gallery.json, data/styles.json or anything under images/ runs `node validate.js --staged` (#1); data/gallery.json, data/styles.json or data/vault-data.js runs `node bundle.js --staged`, refused when the staged bundle does not match the staged JSON (#32); data/round-log.jsonl runs `node round-log.js --staged`, refused on a malformed row or a row that changes one HEAD holds beyond adding its final_pick (#95); data/corrections-log.jsonl runs `node corrections-log.js --staged`, refused on a malformed row or a row that changes one HEAD holds beyond answering its pending ruling (#166); data/calibration-log.jsonl runs `node calibration-log.js --staged`, refused on a malformed row, a run whose figures disagree with the disagreements listed under them, or any change to a row HEAD holds (#168). Each log checker also refuses where git cannot be read.
.husky/pre-commit.local.JUSTIFIED: fail-safe — a malformed library entry travels into every brief copied from it (lucmoseley/mantahostels#3631 step 2); the page opened from its folder reads only the bundle, so a stale one shows the library a version behind with nothing saying so; the round log holds the founder's first picks, made before he read the critic, the corrections log his corrections in his own words, and the calibration log the critic's only agreement figures, none of which can be recovered or re-measured once rewritten.
.husky/pre-commit.local.DEFEAT: none — fix the fault or row the checker names, append a new row, or run node bundle.js and commit data/vault-data.js with the JSON; a commit touching none of these paths never runs a checker.
